business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Durable-goods lease-to-own through Acima and Rent-A-Center, plus Brigit’s consumer financial health app.

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Acima offers lease-to-own at retail partners’ point of sale, Rent-A-Center rents goods through multiple channels, and Brigit delivers financial health tools through an app.

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Flexible lease payments on rented merchandise and installment payments on retail purchases.

customer_contract_term.label: Customer contract term
customer_contract_term.value: Flexible lease-to-own. Rent-A-Center customers can purchase or return merchandise at any time.

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Repeat lease payments while customers keep rented merchandise, plus installment payments on retail sales.

software_deployment_737_software_service.label: Software deployment [737 software/services]
software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Brigit delivers its financial health tools through a consumer app.

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: Brigit provides budgeting, early access to earned wages, credit building through savings, identity theft protection, and ways to earn and save money.

rental_fleet_utilization_735.label: Rental fleet / utilization [735]
rental_fleet_utilization_735.value: Lease-to-own durable goods through Acima retail partners and Rent-A-Center, including furniture, appliances, electronics, and computers.

notes: The evidence leaves customer retention, subscription metrics, and rental utilization unquantified.
